name: CounterFact+
description: CounterFact+ is an improved specificity benchmark for evaluating model editing techniques in large language models. It extends the existing CounterFact benchmark with a dynamic component and introduces a KL divergence-based metric to better detect unwanted side effects of model edits.
reputation: A well-known benchmark in model editing research, commonly used to measure specificity and side effects alongside CounterFact and related editing suites.
notes: Extends CounterFact benchmark with dynamic component; introduces KL divergence metric for specificity; highlights low specificity in recent model editing techniques.
